entries.title: Psalms 80:1
segments: ¶<To the chief music-maker; put to Shoshannim-eduth. Of Asaph. A Psalm.> Give ear, O Keeper of Israel, guiding Joseph like a flock; you who have your seat on the winged ones, let your glory be seen.

entries.title: Psalms 80:2
segments: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, let your strength be awake from sleep, and come as our salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 80:3
segments: Take us back again, O God; let us see the shining of your face, and let us be safe.

entries.title: Psalms 80:4
segments: O Lord God of armies, how long will your wrath be burning against the rest of your people?

entries.title: Psalms 80:5
segments: You have given them the bread of weeping for food; for their drink you have given them sorrow in great measure.

entries.title: Psalms 80:6
segments: You make us a cause of war among our neighbours; our haters are laughing at us among themselves.

entries.title: Psalms 80:7
segments: Take us back again, O God of armies; let us see the shining of your face, and let us be safe.

entries.title: Psalms 80:8
segments: ¶You took a vine out of Egypt: driving out the nations, and planting it in their land.

entries.title: Psalms 80:9
segments: You made ready a place for it, so that it might take deep root, and it sent out its branches over all the land.

entries.title: Psalms 80:10
segments: The mountains were covered with its shade, and the great trees with its branches.

entries.title: Psalms 80:11
segments: It sent out its arms to the Sea, and its branches to the River.

entries.title: Psalms 80:12
segments: Why are its walls broken down by your hands, so that all who go by may take its fruit?

entries.title: Psalms 80:13
segments: It is uprooted by the pigs from the woods, the beasts of the field get their food from it.

entries.title: Psalms 80:14
segments: Come back, O God of armies: from heaven let your eyes be turned to this vine, and give your mind to it,

entries.title: Psalms 80:15
segments: Even to the tree which was planted by your right hand, and to the branch which you made strong for yourself.

entries.title: Psalms 80:16
segments: It is burned with fire; it is cut down: they are made waste by the wrath of your face.

entries.title: Psalms 80:17
segments: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.

entries.title: Psalms 80:18
segments: So will we not be turned back from you; keep us in life, and we will give praise to your name.

entries.title: Psalms 80:19
segments: Take us back, O Lord God of armies; let us see the shining of your face, and let us be safe.
